name: The Dead Rise
summary: Wickermoor's dead are walking out of Maidenmist Cemetery. Its gravedigger has gone silent, the beacons have gone dark, and the tear into the Shroud is growing.

stages.journal: Late in the Dusk Hour the bells rang and ghasts shrieked through Wickermoor. We fought them off beside Doris Squire's militia.
stages.hint: Find out where the dead came from: ask Mori Shade at the funeral home.

stages.journal: Mori Shade asked us to go to Maidenmist: the gates are chained, the fog thick, no beacon fires, no lantern. She sent us with grave salt.
stages.hint: Take the road south-east to the cemetery gate and follow the Corpse Road up to the sepulcher.

stages.journal: At the sepulcher's doors an orc ghost named Yorgrim and a black hound hold lanterns to the seam, burning back the mist.
stages.hint: Speak with Yorgrim at the great doors.

stages.journal: Yorgrim asked us to relight the five dark beacons with the final rites of the Fallen. The sepulcher doors will open when all six burn. Isolde can hold the door for sixteen hours.
stages.hint: Take one of the seven paths to a beacon site, find its kindling, and perform the rite at the brazier. The Shadestone Stones are safe to rest.

stages.journal: All six beacons burn and the sepulcher's doors have opened onto a hall of coloured fire.
stages.hint: Go through the great doors, and clear the collapsed passage at the far end of the Balefire Chamber.

stages.journal: The passage is clear, and below it lies the undercroft: a catacomb maze above a drake's cave.
stages.hint: Find the way through the catacombs to the Stygian Descent. A fall leads to the necropolis depths, and the depths have a way on.

stages.journal: Down a stair of screaming faces, Yorgrim opened the tomb's door and asked whether we were ready.
stages.hint: Go into the Tomb of the Shrouded with Yorgrim.

stages.journal: Yorgrim broke under the tear and became the Chained Reaper. We destroyed him, and his voice asked us to perform his own rites.
stages.hint: Honour Yorgrim at the lantern on the tomb floor: six words that land true will seal the tear.

stages.journal: The tear is sealed. The depths' balefire is azure again, and the dead of Maidenmist lie quiet.
